**v0.1.10-nightly.20261115.4723** · 221 changes from 92 contributors

- **Resume Cursor turns.** Resume a stopped Cursor turn from its latest checkpoint without sending a new message.
- **Cursor compaction.** Manually compact Cursor conversations from the slash menu or context meter.
- **Large pull request diffs.** Load a pull request file’s diff on demand when it is too large to show automatically.
- **Faster pull request actions.** Pull request actions, title edits, and labels now update immediately across all supported hosts.
- **Faster delegated tasks.** Delegated tasks start and finish faster in long threads.
- **Prompt recovery.** Prompts awaiting provider acceptance are preserved if the server restarts.
- **Scratch thread protection.** Agents can no longer delete the built-in No project workspace and its threads.

- **Faster updates.** Update everything downloads server updates while provider tools install, reducing the wait.
- **Shared document attachments.** Agents can now read documents attached by guests in shared threads.
- **Folder search on macOS.** Find folders with accented names when adding or cloning a project.
- **Stashed prompts.** Stashed prompts retain pasted images and linked environment mentions when restored.
- **Worktree protection.** Deleting a project preserves its worktree cleanup policy, preventing unintended checkout removal.
- **Push deleted branches.** Push now republishes a local branch when its remote branch has been deleted.
- **Provider retry timeout.** Turns stuck in provider retries now fail after 10 minutes instead of running indefinitely.

- **OpenCode updates.** OpenCode updates now restart its background service automatically, so the new version is ready to use.
